verdictEs: TarkovTracker si tu prioridad es team sync, open-source y minimalism. Tarkov Advisor si quieres tier list, stash management y UX visual con un solo login.
verdictEn: TarkovTracker if your priority is team sync, open-source, and minimalism. Tarkov Advisor if you want tier list, stash management, and visual UX with a single login.

useCases.labelEs: Wipe en grupo con 3-5 jugadores compartiendo progreso
useCases.labelEn: Group wipe with 3-5 players sharing progress
useCases.reasonEs: Team sync más maduro con required-items agregados — la feature flagship que justifica usarlo.
useCases.reasonEn: More mature team sync with aggregated required items — the flagship feature justifying it.

useCases.labelEs: Decidir qué loot mantener cuando el stash está lleno
useCases.labelEn: Decide what loot to keep when stash is full
useCases.reasonEs: Tier list de value-per-slot + stash inventory que TarkovTracker no maneja.
useCases.reasonEn: Value-per-slot tier list + stash inventory that TarkovTracker doesn't handle.

useCases.labelEs: Tracker simple solo para track de tasks personales
useCases.labelEn: Simple tracker just for personal task progress
useCases.reasonEs: UX más limpia y minimalista, sin features extra que distraen.
useCases.reasonEn: Cleaner and more minimalist UX without distracting extra features.

useCases.labelEs: Planificar hideout upgrades con visualización de dependencias
useCases.labelEn: Plan hideout upgrades with dependency visualization
useCases.reasonEs: Tiene planner gráfico con dependency tree; TarkovTracker solo lista módulos pendientes.
useCases.reasonEn: It has a graphical planner with dependency tree; TarkovTracker only lists pending modules.

useCases.labelEs: Contribuir al desarrollo con PRs o features custom
useCases.labelEn: Contribute to development with PRs or custom features
useCases.reasonEs: Open-source en GitHub con community activa de contributors; Advisor es closed-source.
useCases.reasonEn: Open-source on GitHub with active contributor community; Advisor is closed-source.
